reasons.persona_fit: Perfect fit for an owner-operator; calm, practical tone, respects the no-CTA rule, and clearly maintains Bareni's boundary that human approval controls money movement.
reasons.clarity: Exceptionally clear, structured, and easy to follow. Directly addresses late payment term tracking without jargon or unnecessary complexity.
reasons.actionability: Offers an immediate, feasible, low-friction next step (auditing one week of invoices and review time) before making any software or build commitments.
reasons.factual_grounding: Fully grounded and honest. Explicitly qualifies the workflow as a pilot design rather than a deployed customer system, avoiding any fabricated metrics or claims.
